class_definition.ambiguous_name: the basename states two or more distinct dates (a range name)
class_definition.no_date_in_name: the basename states no ISO or compact date
class_definition.no_payload_date: the name states a date and the payload states none anywhere the scan looks: unmeasured, never a negative
class_definition.not_a_json_object: the member is not a .json object
class_definition.payload_before_family_span: the closest payload date precedes every date the siblings' names state: a data date, not a write date
class_definition.payload_one_day_earlier: the closest payload date is the day before the name date and is not before the family's own earliest dated name
class_definition.payload_one_day_later: the closest payload date is the day after the name date
class_definition.payload_outside_one_day: the closest payload date is two or more days from the name date
class_definition.same_day: the payload states the day the name states (compared on the closest payload date)
class_definition.unreadable_member: the member is missing on disk or does not parse

method_limits: the comparison uses the closest payload date after preferring the best witness tier: a payload that states several days is summarised by one, and the full set is published per row (payload_dates, tiers_seen)
a date inside a long prose string is a witness of the same rank as prose anywhere else: one day inside a paragraph is not a stamp a writer can be held to
family spans come from the population's own names; a family whose dated siblings are all outside E472's member list reads unmeasurable, never inside
writer evidence is a source-level signal (the literal plus a write verb within two lines), not dataflow: a write in another module through a helper is not attributed
title: why do two vintages named for one day state the day before?

witness_tiers.frozen: one of the seven frozen names at the payload's top level
witness_tiers.non_frozen: another structured string field at depth <= 2 whose value is a bare date
witness_tiers.prose: a date mentioned inside a longer free-text string
